description: I'd like to experiment with that peculiar slime the Brachydios secretes—oh, it'll be 100% safe, don't you worry! Heh... And if you help, I'm sure it'll help our Ancient Tree some, too! (Unlocks a Botanical Research slot on first time completion.)

name: Festival of Explosions!
description: I've been going bonkers thinkin' about how I can upgrade your specialized tools. You get me the materials I need and I'll make sure your gear's upgrade'll be straight fire! (Upgrades the Fireproof Mantle upon first completion.)

name: Noblefrost Hunter
description: How that Legiana got a cloak of ice like that is a mystery, but it's nothing science can't solve! We'll need all the data you can get on that thing!

name: Tundra Troublemaker
description: —and by the by, you've come snout to snout with the Fulgur Anjanath, yes? How a brute wyvern could somehow make its way to the Hinterlands! Astounding, yes? How can it even swi—

name: Duet of Rime
description: I've been going bonkers thinkin' about how I can upgrade your specialized tools. You go out and get me the materials I need and I'll hook you up with a cool upgrade! (Upgrades the Iceproof Mantle upon first completion.)

name: Treasure in the Steam
description: Duuuude! I got these sick drafts cooked up! Just, uh, they need a few more tweaks. Yo, help me out with this quest, and stuff, and you can get a special ticket. Pretty sweet, right?

name: Special Arena: MR Azure Rathalos
description: A new challenger: Azure Rathalos, the Sapphire Sultan, the True Blue Terror! Bow down to the king of all wyverns! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: Special Arena: MR Black Diablos
description: A new challenger: Black Diablos, the Dark Destroyer, the Horn Express! Run, don't walk, from this furious fiend! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: Special Arena: MR Acidic Glavenus
description: A new challenger: Acidic Glavenus, the Colonel of Corrosion, The Dino Dueler! There's no stoppin' once he gets to choppin'! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: Special Arena: MR Ebony Odogaron
description: A new challenger: Ebony Odogaron, the Overlord of Onyx, the Hell-hound that Pounds! He'll teach you to sit, roll over, and play dead! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: Special Arena: MR Fulgur Anjanath
description: A new challenger: Fulgur Anjanath, the Shock-o-saurus, T-Wrecks! He's electric! Boogie Woogie, Woogie! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: These Azure Eyes See All
description: We've got reports coming in from all locations confirming the existence of some unusually tough monsters. Head to their locations and begin your investigations ASAP.

name: Misfortune in the Forest
description: Some of the newly discovered monsters in the New World have been sighted in other locales. The shift in surroundings will most likely have a significant effect on their behavior, head to their location and investigate immediately.

name: In the Heat of the Moment
description: It seems that one of our researchers was set on by a Black Diablos and during the encounter he spilt attractant all over himself. Now the lovesick beast is chasing him all over the wastes...

name: Piercing Black
description: I've been going bonkers thinkin' about how I can upgrade your specialized tools. You get me the materials I need and no monster will be knocking you around! (Upgrades the Rocksteady Mantle upon first completion.)

name: A Shadowy Offender
description: "I'm on the trail of an Ebony Odogaron. It's a ferocious monster that seems to have a thirst for battle. I must take care not—" (the rest of the note is torn...)

name: This Corroded Blade
description: —and by the by, you've dueled with the Acidic Glavenus, yes? How it sharpens that dull, acidic tail into a beautiful blade! Simply astounding, yes! Oh, and the way it winds up for an—

name: The Purr-fect Room: Light Iron
description: P.U.R.R. is in fur effect...with just one minor hiccup: an Acidic Glavenus! Bag us that Glavenus and we'll sneak past and snatch the goods! (Decor materials for your room added upon first completion.)

name: The Purr-fect Room: Dark Iron
description: P.U.R.R. is in fur effect...with just one minor hiccup, well, actually two: a double dose of depraved devil doggies! Put 'em on a leash so we can go in and get the goods! (Decor materials for your room added upon first completion.)

name: Blue Rathalos Blues
description: Azure Rathalos are known to mark their territory with gashes by using their massive claws. As fascinating as this is to our ethology department, it's quite a headache for our geologists.

name: Trap the Thunder Jaw
description: I've been going bonkers thinkin' about how I can upgrade your specialized tools. You get me the materials I need and I'll upgrade your gear lightning-quick! (Upgrades the Thunderproof Mantle upon first completion.)

name: Clashing Swords Upon The Rime
description: Official records about Velkhana are non-existent, and much has yet to be confirmed about its ecology. But this is the perfect opportunity for us—er, YOU, to make history!

name: The Harbinger of Clear Skies
description: Sure, Kushala Daora wrecks things with its storms, but I think it gets a bad rap. I mean, after those storms, it's super sunny and everything! Help me change people's minds!

name: Here Comes the Deathmaker
description: ...... So, the stories are true. A Vaal Hazak, in the Ancient Forest. Time for you to get to work, Hunter. Run along, now.

name: Royal Audience on the Sand
description: A member of the Fourth encountered a Teostra in the Waste, one more terrible than usual. The emperor sits on its throne, waiting. Shall we pay him a visit?

name: The Tyrant's Banquet
description: I've been going bonkers thinkin' about how I can upgrade your specialized tools. You go out and get me the materials I need and the status of your gear is sure to go up! (Upgrades the Apothecary Mantle upon first completion.)

name: Lightning Crashes
description: An unusual amount of lightning and radiance has occurred in the Highlands recently. This must be a sign that a Kirin is active in the area. You MUST look into this, Hunter!

name: Memories of the Sea God
description: Namielle is a truly terrifying beast, capable of summoning torrents as well as lightning! We must gather as much data as possible. I ask that you head out immediately, and of course, be careful!

name: It's the Afterlife for Me
description: I've been going bonkers thinkin' about how I can upgrade your specialized tools. Your gear might be immune to abnormal status effects but it ain't immune to my upgrades! (Upgrades the Immunity Mantle upon first completion.)

name: Wings of the Wind
description: Black tornadoes have been spotted in the Elder's Recess. Analytics believes this is the work of a Kushala Daora, and a very nasty one at that. I'll leave this one to you, bud.

name: Mark of the Sun
description: The Huntsman and I tried to take on a Teostra, but it was too much for us. We need you to head out to the Elder's Recess and provide assistance. As in, you take care of it!

name: Seething with Anger
description: So I heard this new Bazelgeuse is supposed to be red-hot. But do you think it can match MY red-hot passion for life? Uh, DOUBT IT! Let's go out and cool down that fool!

name: The Purr-fect Room: Silver
description: P.U.R.R. is in fur effect...with just one minor hiccup: a Bazelgeuse! Maybe if you say its name three times, we can sneak in and get the goods! Go on, give it a try! (Decor materials for your room added upon first completion.)

name: We Run This Town
description: You've overcome everything thrown at you so far, why not just one more challenge? Come out of this unscathed, and no one will forget why you're the real Sapphire Star!

name: Special Arena: MR Zinogre
description: A new challenger: Zinogre, the Bug Zapper, the Thunder Clapper! When this pup gets to howlin', better throw the towel in! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: Special Arena: MR Yian Garuga
description: A new challenger: Yian Garuga, the Screamin' Demon, the Beaked Berzerker! You've never seen crazy like this before! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: Special Arena: MR Brute Tigrex
description: A new challenger: Brute Tigrex, the Aggro Assaulter, the Bellowing Blitzer! He's talkin' trash with the moves to back it up! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: Special Arena: MR Gold Rathian
description: A new challenger: Gold Rathian, The Queen of Sheen, the Lethal Lunar Lady! She may be golden but she'll leave you black and blue. Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: Special Arena: MR Silver Rathalos
description: A new challenger: Silver Rathalos, the Glistening Gladiator, the Fireball Flinger! He reigns over the ring with a rain of fire! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: Faraway Lorelei
description: Gotta admit, Shara Ishvalda is one elder dragon that is a sight to behold. Still can't believe it led us all the way here. We still have much to learn, let's pay it another visit!

name: Hymn of Moon and Sun
description: I've been going bonkers thinkin' about how I can upgrade your specialized tools. You get me the materials I need and I guarantee this upgrade will have massive impact! (Upgrades the Impact Mantle upon first completion.)

name: The Storm Brings the Unexpected
description: I've been going bonkers thinkin' about how I can upgrade your specialized tools. You get me the materials I need and I guarantee you'll just love this upgrade! (Upgrades the Affinity Booster upon first completion.)

name: One Hot Night in the Spire
description: Lunastra...I saw her just once and tried to express my feelings, but it was not meant to be. Oh, to be caressed by her flames... I need someone to tell her how I feel!

name: Divine Surge
description: I've been going bonkers thinkin' about how I can upgrade your specialized tools. You get me the materials I need and I'll make sure your gear is truly next generation! (Upgrades the Temporal Mantle upon first completion.)

name: Into the Palace of Flame
description: A request to track down a Lunastra has come in! I wonder what it's like to be treated like an empress. Take this quest, mon étoile, and show me...

name: Master Hunter of the New World
description: You've had your rough patches, but you've become a shining beacon for the Commission. So here's to you, one last quest. May your name be etched in history!

name: Special Arena: MR Stygian Zinogre
description: A new challenger: Stygian Zinogre, the Dean of Dracophage, the Mighty Mephisto! You better be hungry like the wolf if you wanna survive! Two fighters enter the Special Arena, but only one leaves!

name: All That Glitters is Furious
description: We know of the Furious Rajang, but only just that. Do you know why? Because when it spots you, it's already over. Can our Sapphire Star stand up to the golden fury?

name: Achy Brachy Heart
description: My senior hunting friend went off to slay a Raging Brachydios once, and when I asked about it she just said, "I just don't think you'd understand." Can you believe that? I almost blew up at her! Now I have to go see it for myself.

name: Pearl Snatchers
description: Ooooh! My best assistant came to lend me a hand! Think you can catch me some of those fluffy duffy Pearlspring Macaques? For what? Duh! To play with—er, I mean to research of course, you silly hunter! (Special material rewards upon completion.)

name: Duffel Duty
description: You ready to lend me a hand? Oh, goodie! I need you to capture some Duffel Penguins for me. You gotta be quick, though. They'll give you the flipper then you give you the slip! (Special material rewards)

name: Flora Frostbite
description: The Reach is so cold your ears will fall off, or so I heard. Earmuffs would do the trick, or maybe some—!? I got it! Yes, INSPIRATION! To the message boards! (Special material rewards)

name: Trophy Fishin'
description: Don't think you can eat 'em and I know gramps would be reel upset if I plopped one down in front of him for supper. But sounds like mighty good fun tangoin' with two tundra trouts! (Increased HR/MR points and special material rewards upon completion.)

name: The Lord of the Underworld Beckons
description: Those things—like felvine, I tell ya! I just can't get enough! If you can go meow-t and get your paws on some more, I'd really a-purr-eciate it! I'll even reward you with lots of bone materials fur your troubles! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: A Bunch of Sticks in the Mud
description: Some roaming Banbaro have adapted to the Wildspire and are using mounds of mud to attack hunters! Careful out there, everyone! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Desert Desserts
description: Ah, Hunter! I've caught wind of a delicacy called a Hardfruit, which makes for a delightful snack. It's a bit of a trek, but bring some back for me and I'll reward you with lots of ore! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: A Fish to Whet Your Appetite
description: Not only are those big boys sharp to a fault, if you can haul them here fresh as a daisy, they might be useful as a weapon too! So get on out there and snag some, will ya? (Special material rewards)

name: Fetching Light Pearls
description: I saw those Kelbi eyes glow like a pearl in the dark! Then it struck me. Yes, INSPIRATION! To the message boards! (Special material rewards)

name: To Our World
description: Why is that thing still alive? I thought we killed it! Does that mean I'm in the...? At any rate, I need to find a way back to my world. In this quest, you will get to play as Artemis.

name: The New World
description: Looks like I'm back in this world again, but where are those two? Guess I better look for them... In this quest, you will get to play as Artemis.

name: Skyward Snipers
description: You've seen those big Grandfather Mantagrells being all floaty in the air, right? My notes say they're especially weak to sudden shocks. I bet if you use your slinger you can get one for me to play with—I mean study, of course! (Special material rewards)

name: Every Hunter's Dream II
description: A hunter came by with blueprints for Palico equipment they wanted me to craft. I still have the prints lying around, so if you want one of your own, get me the materials and I'll start workin'. (Special material rewards)

name: Paolumu Lullabies
description: The Admiral and Chef managed to capture a Nightshade Paolumu, but something seemed pawfully off. I didn't mention anything to those two, but purrhaps you could take a look, Meowster?

name: Balloon Fight
description: OK. I, uh, admit that I went a little crazy with the party prep, but I swear I did NOT blow up those balloons. Pop those pests and the Second Fleet Master will hook you up with armor spheres!

name: A New Troublemaker in Town
description: —and you know what would be fascinating? Hunting an Anjanath AND a Banbaro at the same time! I would certainly dole out more HR/MR points to any hunter who'd take up that challenge! Yes, can you imagine it, Hunter? Going at it with those two brutes—

name: Colorful Carnival
description: Yeah, time to get it done! I got an assignment from the scholars to pick up a couple of whatcha-ma-call-sacs. I'm gonna do it all in one go! (Increased HR/MR points upon completion.)

name: Hunter-Blunderer
description: We were supposed to go out to get some stuff for Analytics, but my partner goofed and went on a different quest! Can you take care of this while I fetch him? Geez...this bozo. (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Camoflawed
description: The young miss I work with needs to research some critter in a Rath nest and almost went wearin' an herbivore disguise. Good thing I stopped her before she got swooped up. Could you go hunt that Rathian so she can get her critter fix? (Special material rewards)

name: Kadachi Twins
description: It's so freakin' cold out here that I came up with a design for some warm armor based on a monster! It looks strong, yes, strong indeed! (Special material rewards)

name: Every Hunter's Dream III
description: A hunter came by with a blueprint of a weapon they wanted. I still have the prints lying around, so if you want one of your own, get me the materials and I'll start workin'. (Special material rewards)

name: 50 Shades of White
description: To all hunters who yearn for action in the Arena, this quest is for you! Go head to head with our combatants, and earn special materials to craft weapons! (Special material rewards)

name: A Sky & Sea of Fire
description: They're everywhere! I can hear the treacherous wings of fire above me, and I can feel the smoldering glare coming from that lava! Help! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: A Curious Experiment
description: Hey, what do you think would happen if a Diablos charged at an inflated Paolumu? I've been thinking about this for way too long and now I can't sleep. Do you think you can find out for me? (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Soaked and Shivering
description: I was SO looking forward to going out on a hunt in a place that's not cold, but it IS cold. FREEZING COLD! And it's wet too! That's it! I am SO done. I'm going home... (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Fired-Up Bruisers
description: —to hunt a Glavenus AND an Uragaan simultaneously, yes! That's the stuff dreams are made of! I'd most certainly dole out extra HR/MR points upon completion to the hunters who—

name: When the Swift Meets the Roar
description: Expect things to get hot and tense in this quest! But don't worry, you'll get your fill of decorations if you come out of this in one piece! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Seeing is Believing
description: Yo, Scrawny. This hungover hunter came by sayin' he's seein' things in the Arena. He was so shook up about it that it's made him quit drinkin'. Go check it out for him, will ya? (Special material rewards)

name: Beef is Never a Mi-steak
description: No matter how much I chow down, I'm never full. Guess I'm still a growing boy! I need my protein, or maybe—!? I got it! Yes, INSPIRATION! To the message boards! (Special material rewards)

name: The Desert Dash
description: Scouts have spotted a couple of highly dangerous monsters speeding across the Wildspire. Head to the locale and take care of both threats! And don't be late! (Increased HR/MR points upon completion)

name: In the Depths of the Forest
description: They say that Anjanaths are built for the forest. They roam it like kings, but now that an Azure Rathalos has showed up, we got a real fight on our hands! (Increased HR/MR points upon completion.)

name: Servants of the Vale
description: Two monsters have staked claim to the Rotten Vale, Hunter. But no matter who wins, the Commission loses. We need someone like you to get in there and drive both of them out! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Scores of Ores
description: Dang, mining is a workout! If I had a cooler pickaxe maybe this wou—...!? I got it! Yes, INSPIRATION! To the message boards! (Special material rewards)

name: A Chilling Entrance
description: It's cold today, better get a scarf to warm up. I wonder what'll happen if I wrap my hea—...!? I got it! INSPIRATION! To the message boards! (Special material rewards)

name: Farewell to the Frozen
description: To the hunters who have survived the dangers of the New World, I hope you can display your full potential one more time. Show them that the Sapphire Star can never be frozen!

name: Talk About a Party Foul...
description: Wooo, that was one GNARLY party! But some, uh, party pooper left all his party poop all over the place... Sorry, Player. Someone's gotta clean up this mess and it ain't me! But if you do, the Second Fleet Master will hook you up with some sweet armor spheres!

name: We Three Kings
description: Thunder. Wind. Fire. Nature's wonders in their purest form. So, we fight purity with purity. Pick your weapon, hunter. And fight. (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: The Winter Blues
description: This cold reminds me of the Hinterlands, but it drips with an eerie, tranquil smell. This must be looked into, yes? Run along now... (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: A Reason Behind The Hunger
description: Perhaps the reason why this type of Deviljho is constantly hunting is that it's lost its ability to feel full? Perhaps I can empathize with its plight. I too, crave... My hunger for knowledge is insatiable! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: RE: Return of the Bioweapon
description: We've discovered a strange condition which is horrifyingly unaffected by <STYL MOJI_RED_DEFAULT>effluvial resistance! If it's not effluvial buildup, then what is it? Help us, Hunter, and you'll be generously compensated! (Special material rewards)

name: The Assassin
description: I dreamt of a man with the grace of an assassin...and ever since, I've been going bonkers thinking about what I want to work on next. Ya gotta help me out here! (Upgrades the Assassin's Hood upon first completion.)

name: USJ: Shine On Forever
description: Special delivery from USJ to you: the perfect stage for you to sparkle with a monster that truly shines! May the shine never end! (Special material rewards)

name: USJ: Ballet of Frost
description: Special delivery from USJ to you: the perfect stage for you to duel with a monster with fangs of frost! May the excitement never end! (Special material rewards)

name: The Red Dragon
description: Safi'jiiva, the mature form of Xeno'jiiva... Reports confirm that it's siphoning energy from its surroundings to heal its wounds. We need to eliminate this threat before it's too late!

name: Muscle Monkey Madness
description: Boy, I wish I could be as strong as you hunters! Maybe instead of getting buff, I could wear—!? I got it! Yes, INSPIRATION! To the message boards! (Special material rewards)

name: A Shocking Climax
description: I have located the ones who command the thunder. I left the task to a group of Fifth Fleet hunters, but they have yet to return. It's up to you now. (Special material rewards)

name: Moonlit Howl
description: I saw a Zinogre in the Coral Highlands! This is it—the perfect opportunity for a study case on Fulgurbugs in the New World! I won't rest until I—until YOU get me some specimens! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: I Am Tranquil, I Am Sound
description: My purr-ank-loving furr-iend told me about this meownster that's the definition of "calm"! I gotta see it for myself! Maybe I should take some earplugs...? Nah, I'll be fine! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: A Roar that Splinters the Sky
description: As soon as we heard that roar in the distance, the hunter I was with sounded the retreat. Good thing, too—had we heard that roar up close, well, I'm sure I would have been its dinner! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: A Glance of Silver
description: At first I thought it was just some light glancing off the rocks in the Elder's Recess, but it was HIM. I never thought I'd live to see this day! It makes me glad I came to the New World. (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: The Moon is a Harsh Queen
description: The golden empress has been spotted. We need the Fifth to prepare and head out. Take care, or the empress may turn the tables on you before you know it. (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Razzled, Frazzled, and Dazzled
description: The Admiral and some Fivers were talking some absolutely nonsense when they went off on a quest to hunt a Rajang. The Research Commission sure has a lot of hairballed hunters, huh? (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Scars Tell the Whole Story
description: Us hunters have seen a lot of crazy stuff in our day, but nothing comes close to personifying crazy as that big purple chicken does! Don't lose your cool now. (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Yodeling in the Forest
description: The Ancient Forest is a living maze, so it's not every day we see this many monsters duking it out. This could be a huge boon to our research, so suit up and head out!

name: Heavy Metal in the Waste
description: The Wildspire is a vast stretch of land, so it's not every day we see this many monsters duking it out. This could be a huge boon to our research, so suit up and head out!

name: Symphony of the Coral
description: The Coral Highlands is relatively peaceful, so it's not every day we see this many monsters duking it out. This could be a huge boon to our research, so suit up and head out!

name: Rotten Canzone
description: The monsters in the Rotten Vale are usually combative, but today they're especially irritated. This could be a huge boon to our research, so suit up and head out!

name: Alt Rock Recess
description: The monsters in the Elder's Recess are used to hanging tough, but today they're especially irritated. This could be a huge boon to our research, so suit up and head out!

name: Ballad of the Hoarfrost
description: The monsters of the Reach tend to keep to themselves, but today they're at each other's throats! This could be a huge boon to our research, so suit up and head out!

name: Wolf Out of Hell
description: My apologies. I spent years researching monsters, giving everything to the Commission. But I lost everything to THIS one. I need you to step in, for I fear I won't be able to keep my cool. (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: The Wrath of Thunder Descends
description: They say lightning never strikes the same place twice, but I wouldn't take my chances here! Get through this in one piece and you'll get your fill of decorations! (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Ode to the Destruction
description: Scouts have sighted an unusually fierce Ruiner Nergigante out in the field. We need you to investigate. Expect some Great Spiritvein Gems as a reward for your trouble. (Bonus HR/MR points rewarded upon completion.)

name: Mighty Muscle Monkey Madness
description: Yeah, hunters are something else. "This won't do... I'm not satisfied", they said with a fire in their eye. Their passion for muscles easily surpasses my inspiration! (Special material rewards)

name: Don't Forget The Earplugs!
description: An awfully big Shepherd Hare is inside the arena. Looks a bit different from the usual variety, but no mistaking it's a Shepherd Hare with those ears! You wanna take a look and get some INSPIRATION too!? (Special material rewards)

name: Monkey Business
description: I just spotted a gigantic Goldspring Macaque! No, seriously! The way it roars into the sky and that electric golden fur, there's no mistaking it! It's going to be my source of INSPIRATION! (Special material rewards)

name: The Naked Truth
description: I've suddenly reached enlightenment. I now know the truth! All life cannot attain their true potential unless they take the same form as when they came into this world. And that means...INSPIRATION! (Special material rewards)

name: Tears from Nirvana
description: When people travel to the other side, there are places full of fear and sadness that you must bear alone. You'll know that same feeling if you face a Blackveil Vaal Hazak. (Special material rewards)

name: A Farewell to Zinogre
description: The most hunted monster ever, how wonderful! Let me throw you hunters a curveball and offer a slightly different Zinogre! Those shiny things on the ground may look tempting, but be careful not to get a paw to the face!

name: Brand New Brute
description: Whoa, no wonder this Brute Tigrex's so clean, it's the least hunted monster! Is it crying tears of joy? Wait, those tears look a lot like armor spheres...hmm. Odd. (You cannot obtain monster materials from this quest)

name: Mew are Number One!
description: Meow, child, we all know that you are the Commission's number one hunter. The only thing you're missing is a golden trophy, so I've gone and fixed up a quest for you to go out and get one. I even threw in a few goodies too. Be back in time fur dinner, meow!

name: The Evening Star
description: Alatreon has been sighted in the Secluded Valley. It seethes, like a burning star that revels in the darkness. But it's time for the Commission to let the world know of this blazing black abomination!

name: Dawn of the Death Star
description: Alatreon has been sighted in the Secluded Valley. It screams, like an icy dead star that rejects the light. But it's time for the Commission to let the world know of this blazing black abomination!

name: In the Tempest's Wake
description: When I was a young girl, a Kushala Daora passed by our village. We hid in our homes, afraid of what tragedy it might leave in its wake. And now it's here... May this Sealed Feystone be incentive enough for you to put a stop to this tempest.

name: Day of Ruin
description: A blazing sun in a sunless land—I guess every life burns as brightly as it can, no matter where it finds itself. Just like we did those forty years ago... Anyway, I've prepared a Sealed Feystone for after you've laid this sun to rest.

name: The Cold Never Bothered Me
description: We've driven the "Blue Flame" into the cold prison of the supply cache, but now it seems to burn brighter than ever in its defiance. Extinguish it before it burns us all, and I'll reward your efforts with a Sealed Feystone.

name: The Distant Dark Tide
description: My mother used to lead a hunting party and told me once of a story where pleasant weather turned to violent storms, forcing the party back and spoiling a fine expedition. Perhaps the cause was Namielle. I hope your hunt divulges some answers...

name: The Last White Knight
description: We've finally found it! The tree top assassin that controls the frost. "The Last White Knight", they call it. Outmuscling it is out of the question. No, only the most devoted can topple this beast. I await your report, Hunter.

name: The Place Where Winter Sleeps
description: As leader of this hunt, I've been granted authority to add new recruits to our ranks. Our target is an incredibly ferocious Velkhana. Want a challenge? Then help us send it to its end!

name: Fade to Black
description: We've been tasked with slaying Fatalis, a monster known only in legends handed-down. This beast will test all of your limits, but I know you'll be ready.

name: Old Dog, New Trick
description: What a proud figure I must make, sitting here with my arms crossed. But perhaps I should learn the ways of the new generation, starting with the clutch claw? I heard a Gold Melding Ticket would be the prize, heh.

name: Arena Master Quest 01
description: In the monster corner: Banbaro, the Ruler of the Reach, the Champ of Tramp! If you can't dig your own grave, he'll dig it for you! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: Arena Master Quest 02
description: In the monster corner: Nightshade Paolumu, the Sultan of Slumber, the Flightmare! Get caught in the sleeper hold, and it's lights out! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: Arena Master Quest 03
description: In the monster corner: Nargacuga, the Shadowy Slayer, the Nimble Ninja! If you can't see him, it's already too late! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: Arena Master Quest 04
description: In the monster corner: Acidic Glavenus, the Colonel of Corrosion, The Dino Dueler! There's no stoppin' once he gets to choppin'! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: Arena Master Quest 05
description: In the monster corner: An Odogaron-Ebony Odogaron tag team! The hounds are out, and you're about to get woofed! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: Arena Master Quest 06
description: In the monster corner: Zinogre, the Bug Zapper, the Thunder Clapper! When this pup gets to howlin', better throw the towel in! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: Arena Master Quest 07
description: In the monster corner: A Tigrex-Brute Tigrex tag team! Don't get between these two, unless you wanna be a wishbone! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: Challenge Quest 1: MR Intermediate
description: In the monster corner: A Tobi-Kadachi-Viper Tobi-Kadachi tag team! Stay on your toes against this tandem because the fur is about to fly! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: The True Tyrant
description: We salute all hunters who have conquered the New World using everything at their disposal. Embark on this quest that will challenge you and may the Sapphire Star light your way!

name: Challenge Quest 2: MR Intermediate
description: In the monster corner: An Anjanath-Fulgur Anjanath tag...team...? Bless their hearts, I think their lil' ol' arms are too short to tag... You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: The Conqueror of Hoarfrost
description: We salute all hunters who have conquered the New World using everything at their disposal. Embark on this quest that will challenge you and may the Sapphire Star light your way!

name: A Star That Will Never Dim
description: We salute all hunters who have conquered the New World using everything at their disposal. Embark on this quest that will challenge you and may the Sapphire Star light your way!

name: Wearer of the Iceborne Crown
description: We salute all hunters who have conquered the New World using everything at their disposal. Embark on this quest that will challenge you and may the Sapphire Star light your way!

name: Aiming for the Light
description: We salute all hunters who have conquered the New World using everything at their disposal. Embark on this quest that will challenge you and may the Sapphire Star light your way!

name: Challenge Quest 1: MR Expert
description: In the monster corner: Yian Garuga, the Screamin' Demon, the Beaked Berzerker! You've never seen crazy like this before! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: Challenge Quest 2: MR Expert
description: In the monster corner: Deviljho, the food chain dominator, the pulverizing pickle! This is one hoss that likes to throw its weight around! You ready to duke it out with set weapons and armor?

name: Fear No Scars
description: We salute all hunters who have conquered the New World using everything at their disposal. Embark on this quest that will challenge you and may the Sapphire Star light your way!

name: Power and Technique
description: We salute all hunters who have conquered the New World using everything at their disposal. Embark on this quest that will challenge you and may the Sapphire Star light your way!

name: Reveal Thyself, Destroyer
description: We've traced whatever broke the Kirin's horn to the Guiding Lands. You can bet your bottom zenny that it's one tough customer, so don't let your guard down. And don't be late!

name: Sterling Pride
description: You hear the rumors of ol' Shattered Horn? Sounds like it's shown up in the Hoarfrost Reach, but why it's there and why its horn is broken is as clear as mud! Sounds like a mystery worth investigating, eh?

name: Across the Lost Path
description: We've discovered a new path in the Guiding Lands that even monsters tread carefully around. This may not be an issue from a long-term perspective, but it warrants an investigation.

name: Point of No Return
description: We need you to do some recon on that red monster. Remember, don't get in over your head. Get in, find out what you need, then get out.

name: ...And My Rage for All
description: A Raging Brachydios has been spotted in the Guiding Lands. Not many hunters have faced one and come back in one piece. Think you can join their ranks?

name: The Fury Remains
description: A Furious Rajang has been spotted in the Hoarfrost Reach. Not many hunters have faced one and come back in one piece. Think you can join their ranks?

name: Blazing Black Twilight
description: Not much is known of Alatreon, other than the destruction it's capable of threatens all of humanity. But this is a chance for the Commission to write history, no?

name: Dawn's Triumph
description: The burning Alatreon has once again been spotted. To make matters worse, news has spread of cataclysmic natural disasters occurring in the Old World. The timing of these events is curious to say the least. They merit further investigation but Alatreon comes first.

name: The Black Dragon
description: It is time for us to confront Fatalis. We, along with every nation and organization known, shall rid this world of this fabled scourge. When you're ready, we'll set sail.

name: The Eternal Gold Rush
description: The mother goddess has reappeared. This time, our objective is to slay her. Get the quest from your handler or the quest board. Stand tall against her fury and return safely!

name: Banquet in the Earthen Hall
description: The mother goddess has appeared again, but now that we have the Fifth here, we can finally complete the investigation that we started decades ago! We're counting on you kids!

name: The Fury of El Dorado
description: The old girl is back and stronger than ever, this time dressed to the nines in a glittering white gold coat! With the First and Fifth working together, we won't let this golden opportunity go to waste!
